# filter nuc

```{r}
# only nuc

hbv_drug <- c("ゼフィックス", "ヘプセラ",
              "ラミブジン", "アデホビル",
              "バラクルード", 
              "エンテカビル", 
              "テノゼット",
              "ベムリディ",
              "テノホビル")
```

```{r}
#hep_drug <- c(hbv_drug, hcv_drug)

hbv_drug_query <- paste0(hbv_drug, collapse = "|")
```

```{r}
df_oral_dem_1 %>%
  bind_rows(df_oral_dem_2) %>%
  filter(str_detect(DRUG_name, hbv_drug_query)) %>%
  count(DRUG_name)
```



```{r}
filter_nuc <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    filter(str_detect(DRUG_name, hbv_drug_query)) %>%
    mutate(across(c(starts_with("M_"), 
                    starts_with("F_"),
                    ends_with("都"),
                    ends_with("道"),
                    ends_with("府"),
                    ends_with("県")), ~ na_if(.x, "-"))) %>%
    mutate(across(c(starts_with("M_"), 
                    starts_with("F_"),
                    ends_with("都"),
                    ends_with("道"),
                    ends_with("府"),
                    ends_with("県")), ~ as.numeric(.x))) %>%
    mutate(NUC = case_when(str_detect(DRUG_name, "ゼフィックス")　~ "LAM",
                           str_detect(DRUG_name, "ヘプセラ錠")　~ "ADF",
                           str_detect(DRUG_name, "バラクルード")　~ "ETV (branded)",
                           str_detect(DRUG_name, "エンテカビル")　~ "ETV (generic)",
                           str_detect(DRUG_name, "テノゼット")　~ "TDF",
                           str_detect(DRUG_name, "ベムリディ")　~ "TAF",
                           .default = NA)) %>%
    relocate(NUC, .after = "DRUG_name")
}
```




```{r}
df_nuc_dem_1 <- df_oral_dem_1 %>%
  filter_nuc()
```

```{r}
df_nuc_dem_1 %>% select(starts_with("M_")) %>% ncol()

df_nuc_dem_1 %>% select(starts_with("F_")) %>% ncol()
```



```{r}
df_nuc_dem_1 %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(M_na = sum(is.na(c_across(starts_with("M_"))))) %>%
  mutate(F_na = sum(is.na(c_across(starts_with("F_")))))
```

```{r}
# no age-sex category with only one NA
df_nuc_dem_1 %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(M_na = sum(is.na(c_across(starts_with("M_"))))) %>%
  mutate(F_na = sum(is.na(c_across(starts_with("F_"))))) %>%
  filter(M_na == 1 | F_na == 1)
```

```{r}
convert_dem_long <- function(x) {
  
  df <- readRDS(x)
  
  df<- df %>%
    filter_nuc() %>%
    pivot_longer(starts_with(c("M_", "F_")), names_to = "SEX_AGE", values_to = "VALUE") %>%
    mutate(SEX = str_extract(SEX_AGE, "^M|^F")) %>%
    mutate(AGE = str_remove(SEX_AGE, "M_|F_")) 
  
  to <- x %>% 
    str_replace("rbind", "nuc/long") %>% 
    str_replace("oral", "nuc") %>%
    str_c("_long")
  
  saveRDS(df, to)
}
```


```{r}
file_rbind_dem <- file_rbind %>% str_subset("dem")
file_rbind_dem 
```



```{r}
for (i in 1:length(path_rbind_dem)){
  convert_dem_long(path_rbind_dem[i])
  print(paste(path_rbind_dem[i] %>% str_extract("(?<=\\/)[^\\/]+$"), "completed"))
}
```

# save prf
```{r}
convert_prf_long <- function(x) {
  
  df <- readRDS(x)
  
  df <- df %>%
    filter_nuc() %>%
    pivot_longer(ends_with(c("都", "道", "府", "県")),
                 names_to = "PRF", values_to = "VALUE")
  
  to <- x %>% 
    str_replace("rbind", "nuc/long") %>% 
    str_replace("oral", "nuc") %>%
    str_c("_long")
  
  saveRDS(df, to)
}
```


```{r}
file_rbind_prf <- file_rbind %>% str_subset("prf")
file_rbind_prf 
```


```{r}
path_rbind_prf <- paste0("../df/rbind/", file_rbind_prf)
path_rbind_prf
```


```{r}
for (i in 1:length(path_rbind_prf)){
  convert_prf_long(path_rbind_prf[i])
  print(paste(path_rbind_prf[i] %>% str_extract("(?<=\\/)[^\\/]+$"), "completed"))
}
```
